items.label: vuln
items.true_tag: Logic error / Bypass Mechanism (honeypot: balanceOf lies)
items.notes: Real deployed honeypot token 'nice' on RobinhoodChain (reversed, see memory robinhoodchain-nice-honeypot). The `_v` modifier silently RETURNS (default 0) instead of executing the body when the caller's tx.origin is not the treasury and the queried account is the LP pair with a non-zero self balance: balanceOf(pair) reports 0 to everyone except the operator, which makes every third-party sell path (router/pair reading balances) fail while the operator can still sell. Not-EIP-compliant view that lies conditionally on tx.origin.
